objects.name: Analytic 1885
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Windows host making direct native Operating System (OS) Application Programming Interface (API) calls that bypass the normal ICS vendor Software Development Kit (SDK) abstraction layer -- direct CreateFile calls against raw device paths, DeviceIoControl calls to ICS hardware driver handles -- from a process not a recognized vendor application. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: edr:Syscall
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: DeviceIoControl or raw socket creation to Industrial Control Systems (ICS) protocol port from process not in authorized ICS applications, bypassing documented vendor Software Development Kit (SDK) call pattern
